glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 冎 (“bone”) + 刂 (= 刀) (“knife”), hence 𠛰 – to cut up bone and flesh. Later, the character was stylized as 別. See also 另.
s_page_origin: Variant of 別, where 𠮠 is replaced with the visually-similar 另. Officially adopted as the simplified form of 彆 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
senses: [bié] to distinguish; to differentiate; to discriminate
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 別; s_page_origin explains the simplified 别.
